item.title: Writing Comedy Genres
item.description: This online short course is a fast, practical deep‑dive into writing comedy for the screen across eight of the most powerful subgenres: horror, romantic, action‑crime, satirical‑political, sci‑fi/fantasy, workplace and family, historical, and musical comedy.

item.title: Screenwriting Fundamentals
item.description: Write a complete short screenplay over this eight-week online short course, learning the core principles that underpin effective screen storytelling. Each week you’ll explore a different element of the craft, from building compelling characters and shaping a clear narrative arc to writing efficient scenes that move the story forward.

item.title: Creative Writing course leaders collaborate to release new book with Bloomsbury Academic
item.description: Two of Falmouth’s course leaders have collaborated to release a collection of essays that interrogate the creative writing workshop model and offer practical suggestions on what is a contemporary approach to creative writing.
